{{Short description|Canadian physicist}}
'''Elizabeth von Hauff''' (born 1977 in [[Toronto]]<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2024-08-14 |date=2024 |publisher=Deutsche Nationalbibliothek |title=Personeneintrag |url=https://d-nb.info/gnd/132148234 |website=d-nb.info}}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>) is a Canadian physicist. Since 2021, she has been the director of the [[Fraunhofer Institute for Electron Beam and Plasma Technology]] in Dresden, and a professor at [[Technische Universität Dresden|TU Dresden]].

== Biography ==
Elizabeth von Hauff was born in [[Toronto]], [[Canada]], and studied physics at the [[University of Alberta]], obtaining a [[BSc]] with honors in 2000.<ref name="uva21">{{cite web|access-date=2024-08-14 |date=2021-01-26 |language=de |publisher=Universiteit van Amsterdam |title=Elizabeth von Hauff named professor by special appointment of Non-Equilibrium Thermodynamics in Energy Conversion |url=https://www.uva.nl/shared-content/uva/en/news/professor-appointments/2021/01/elizabeth-von-hauff-named-professor-by-special-appointment-of-non-equilibrium-thermodynamics-in-energy-conversion.html |website=uva.nl}}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> She started the Masters program in [[renewable energy]] at [[Universität Oldenburg]] in 2001,<ref name="vuteam">{{cite web|access-date=2024-08-14 |date=2013 |language=en |publisher=Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam |title=Team: E. von Hauff |url=http://www.few.vu.nl/~ehf240/EvonHauff.html |website=vu.nl}}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> and completed her [[PhD|doctorate]] in semiconductor physics at the same university with a [[thesis]] entitled “Field effect investigations of charge carrier transport in [[organic semiconductors]]” in 2005.<ref>{{citation|author=Elizabeth von Hauff |date=2005 |id=[[DNB-IDN (identifier)|DNB-IDN]]:&nbsp;[http://d-nb.info/983305439 983305439] |location=Oldenburg |publisher=Universität Oldenburg |title=Field effect investigations of charge carrier transport in organic semiconductors}}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> She continued working there worked there as a [[postdoc]], and completed her [[habilitation]] in experimental physics in 2011.<ref name="vuteam" />

Von Hauff next worked at the [[Fraunhofer Institute for Solar Energy Systems|Fraunhofer Institute for Solar Energy Systems ISE]], and became associate professor of organic photovoltaics in the faculty of physics of the [[Albert-Ludwigs-Universität Freiburg|University of Freiburg]]. She was appointed an associate professor of physics at the [[Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam]] in 2013. In 2021, she also became associate professor of mon-equilibrium [[thermodynamics]] in [[Energy transformation|energy conversion]] at the [[University of Amsterdam]].<ref name="uva21" />

In 2021, she was appointed the director of the Fraunhofer Institute for Electron Beam and Plasma Technology in Dresden, with a secondary appointment as the Chair of Coating Technologies for Electronics at TU Dresden.<ref name="prophy22">{{cite web|access-date=2024-08-14 |date=2021-06-29 |language=de |publisher=Wiley-VCH GmbH |title=Elizabeth von Hauff übernimmt Leitung des Fraunhofer FEP |url=https://www.pro-physik.de/nachrichten/elizabeth-von-hauff-uebernimmt-leitung-des-fraunhofer-fep |website=pro-physik.de}}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> In addition to these positions, she remains a [[visiting professor]] at the Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam.<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2024-08-14 |date=2024 |language=en |publisher=Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam |title=Dr. Elizabeth von Hauff |url=https://research.vu.nl/en/persons/elizabeth-von-hauff |website=vu.nl}}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>

== Research ==
Her research focuses on innovative technologies for electronics, energy technology and sensor technology.<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2022-11-25 |author=Markus Haller |language=de-DE |title=Fraunhofer FEP: Prof. Elizabeth von Hauff ist neue Institutsleiterin |url=https://www.elektroniknet.de/messen-testen/sensorik/prof-elizabeth-von-hauff-ist-neue-institutsleiterin.187463.html}}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> She focuses on fundamental questions at the interface between physics, chemistry and biology in relation to applications in photovoltaics, biosensor technology and wearables. In the field of solar energy generation, she studies the role of dynamic processes at the functional interfaces of energy conversion. She works with surface treatment processes and uses [[Operando spectroscopy|operando characterization]] of layers and interfaces.<ref name="uva21" /><ref>{{cite web|access-date=2024-08-14 |date=2024-07-30 |language=de |publisher=TU Dresden |title=Prof. Dr. rer. nat. habil. Elizabeth von Hauff |url=https://tu-dresden.de/ing/elektrotechnik/ife/das-institut/mitarbeiter/elizabeth-von-hauff |website=tu-dresden.de}}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>
